subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should this PR wait for redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof, or should maintainers accept the source-only session-state timing risk?
rationale: The code path and tests support the timing fix, but this external PR has not shown the reported real Feishu/message-tool path succeeding after the change.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source and focused test evidence, while owning that the reported transport path was not proven here.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no one can produce real transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
